verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships its own agentic workflows: a Screening/Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent. These auto-remediate level 1 alerts, escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, and let humans review or override any agent decision. The API also exposes cases, alerts, risks, case filtering, case decisions and audit trails, so an external agent can pull flagged cases with their context. However, the first-party agent mostly auto-decides rather than presenting recommendations for confirmation, and evidence summarization is never documented. missing for 10: documented evidence-summarization output, an explicit recommend-then-human-confirm flow (vs. auto-remediation with override), depth beyond marketing-page claims, independent/hands-on corroboration.
